title: Does Transportation Mean Transplantation? Impact of New Airline Routes on Sharing of Cadaveric Kidneys
authors: Guihua Wang; Ronghuo Zheng; Tinglong Dai
eligible_reason: Canonical staggered DiD. Binary absorbing treatment TreatmentAfter switches on when an airport pair gains a new direct airline route (pair-specific EventYear; 12 distinct adoption years 2002-2017 in the analysis sample, 11 with pre-periods), with 513 never-treated control pairs; linear regression with airport-pair FE and year FE, clustered by pair; column (1) of Tables 2, 4, 5 and 6 has no controls, and Table 3 column (1) is an unstacked event study with pair and year FE and no controls. Analysis data (aggregated OD-pair-year kidney volumes) are shipped.
design_notes: Balanced airport-pair x year panel 2002-2017 (16 years). Treated pairs: new direct route introduced in EventYear (treatment_pair==1); controls: pairs that never gain a route (control_pair==1); pairs with EventYear==2018 dropped (line 36). Main sample restricts to pairs >= 800 miles apart (airport_dist computed from coordinates, line 86). Estimation by `reg` with full dummy sets TxYear* ODPair*, vce(cl OrgDestAirport). Columns (2)-(4) of every table add candidate features (destination-year averages) and/or donor features (origin-year averages), which are time-varying controls. Table 7 uses a continuous treatment (departures_performed/100 and its square). Full data: 1,958 pairs, 191 treated (EventYear 2002:79 ... 2017:10); analysis sample (dist>=800): 574 pairs, 61 treated with EventYear 2002:7, 2003:2, 2004:1, 2005:8, 2006:2, 2008:2, 2012:8, 2013:6, 2014:8, 2015:13, 2016:2, 2017:2; 7 pairs treated in 2002 are always-treated (no untreated observation). Mean OrganVolume in the analysis sample is 0.13 (many zeros; ln(1+y) outcome).
n_eligible_specs_note: Column (1) of Tables 2-6; Tables 2-6 columns (2)-(4) add time-varying candidate/donor characteristics.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Analysis sample (airport_dist >= 800): EventYear in {2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2008, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017}; the 2002 cohort (7 pairs) is always-treated since the panel starts in 2002, leaving 11 cohorts with pre-periods. Full data: 16 cohorts 2002-2017.
never_treated_note: 513 control pairs in the analysis sample (control_pair==1, never gain a direct route).
always_treated_note: 7 treated pairs with EventYear==2002 (5 in the RobustOutcomeAnalysis sample).

published_estimates.note: outcome multiplied by 100 in the paper

specs.sample_condition: airport_dist >= 800 (miles; great-circle distance between airports); balanced 16-year panel of 574 pairs (61 treated, 513 control) = 9,184 obs
specs.notes: Published: 0.073 (0.030), N = 9,184, adj. R2 0.062. Columns 2-4 add time-varying candidate/donor features (not eligible). 7 of the 61 treated pairs have EventYear==2002 (first panel year) and are always-treated.
